title: Finite positive total mass of the seed μ₀ and of every member μ₀^{x,λ}, and concentration of μ₀ on B_2(0) (parent steps 0(a)–(c), 3)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P, z ∈ ℝ^P and r > 0 with μ(B_{2r}(z)) ≠ 0 and μ(B_{2r}(z)) ≠ ∞, and let μ₀ := ofReal(r⁻¹^n)•(μ⌞B_{2r}(z)).map(dilation z r). Then μ₀(ℝ^P) ≠ 0, μ₀(ℝ^P) ≠ ∞ and μ₀(B_2(0)ᶜ) = 0; and for every x ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0 the measure μ₀^{x,λ} := ofReal(λ⁻¹^n)•μ₀.map(dilation x λ) satisfies μ₀^{x,λ}(ℝ^P) ≠ 0 and μ₀^{x,λ}(ℝ^P) ≠ ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ μ₀ : Measure (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → μ (ball z (2 * r)) ≠ 0 → μ (ball z (2 * r)) ≠ ∞ → μ₀ = ENNReal.ofReal (r⁻¹ ^ n) • (μ.restrict (ball z (2 * r))).map (dilation z r) → μ₀ univ ≠ 0 ∧ μ₀ univ ≠ ∞ ∧ μ₀ (ball (0 : Euclid P) 2)ᶜ = 0 ∧ ∀ (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam)) univ ≠ 0 ∧ (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam)) univ ≠ ∞
